title: SUPER GREAT
body:
What an amazing app! Been searching for a clean, easy to use, decluttered habit tracking app for years - this is simply the best and the greatest. 

Thank you!
author: yqgsu816

title: I like the experience and look of the app
body: The app is not a try and track it kind off app. I like that it encourages you by building a system and trying to urge you to read from well known resources inside the app. One more feature I like is that it doesn’t discourage you when you stop a day (for whatever reason). Your streak can be continued even if you miss one day
